item.title: How AWS Marketplace is using AI agents to meet the rising demand for AI agents
item.summary: # How AWS Marketplace is using AI agents to meet the rising demand for AI agents *Follow ZDNET: *[Add us as a preferred source](https://cc.zdnet.com/v1/otc/00hQi47eqnEWQ6T9d4QLBUc?element=BODY&element_label=Add+us+as+a+preferred+source&module=LINK&object_type=text-link&object_uuid=9cb1c8dd-4ad9-4ac8-8e65-ca3f7be2c386&position=1&template=article&track_code=__COM_CLICK_ID__&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2Fpreferences%2Fsource%3Fq%3Dzdnet.com&view_instance_uuid=fa016a81-2eae-4011-899c-50e881f22005&split_test_identifier=deals_module&split_test_variant=test2)* on Google.* ### ZDNET's key takeaways - AWS Marketplace uses AI agents to meet the rising demand for AI agents. - Agent-powered marketplaces extend support to due diligence and deployment. - Larger enterprise apps still require human sales teams. AWS Marketplace, one of the most well-known application marketplaces catering to enterprises of all sizes, is seeing rapid growth of its stable of AI agents, along with a rising number of traditional application offerings. A year ago, "AI agents" ranked 64th among keyword searches across the marketplace, but now ranks in third place, reported Matt Yanchyshyn, vice president of AWS Mark
